sections.title: Burt's characterisation
sections.line: Burt, chapter on Aries (pdf pp. 23–58): pdf p23, p24, p25 and p37.

quotes.quote: The Age of Aries is a solar, or masculine age. It is the Age of the Ram, of Mars and of the Hero.
Aries’ energy is like the Sun’s rays—clear or conscious, frank, direct, obvious, full of light and heat and visible to all.
Aries, remember, is outward drive and Logos.
When we think of Cardinal Fire (Aries) we think of the competitive drive toward success, of the quest in the outer world

quotes.quote: Both are solar, heroic stories about young, naive, independent, supremely confident heroes.
Mars needs to temper Logos with Eros.
Mars is passionate, but not exactly tender or aware of others’ feelings!
The Aries at the esoteric level has begun to work consciously with Mercury (Logos), his/her spiritual ruler.
belong to the heroic Aries archetype.

sections.title: What Jung says
sections.line: Jung on the ram: Dream Analysis seminar, pdf p448 and p434; CW9ii pdf p101.

quotes.quote: The gods had bull’s horns when the sun was in Taurus, and they had ram’s horns during the Aries period. Then the Fish became the symbol.
The little ram, the time of little shoots and buds.
Attis, the Lord of the sacred Ram and the thousand-eyed shepherd of glittering stars.
